name: Bugalou – Live Chat, AI Chatbot & Announcement Bar
author: Bugalou

sections.description:
Bugalou is a free live chat plugin for WordPress, with an AI chatbot and a shared customer support inbox for your whole team. Visitors chat with you from any page of your website, the AI chatbot answers common questions right away, day and night, and your team takes over whenever a visitor needs a person.

Every live chat lands in the Bugalou inbox, next to your WhatsApp, email, Instagram and Facebook Messenger conversations. One place for all customer support, instead of five apps.

This plugin adds the Bugalou live chat widget to your WordPress site in two minutes. No theme editing, no copy-pasting code.

💬 Free live chat for your WordPress website

Start with the free plan: live chat on your website for 1 user and up to 50 conversations a month, free forever, no credit card needed.

  • Live chat on every page of your WordPress site
  • Real-time conversations with your website visitors
  • Visitors can share their name, email and files in the chat
  • The chat follows the visitor’s language
  • Conversations continue across pages, so visitors never lose their chat
  • Colours, texts and opening hours managed from your Bugalou dashboard
  • Loads asynchronously, so your site stays fast

🤖 AI chatbot that answers your customers 24/7

On paid plans an AI chatbot answers visitors instantly, based on your own knowledge base: your website, your help articles and the answers you add yourself.

  • Instant answers to common questions, day and night
  • Learns from your own content, not from generic text
  • Hands off to a team member whenever a visitor asks for a person, with the full chat history
  • Reply suggestions, conversation summaries and automatic translation for your team
  • No extra charge per AI answer

📥 One inbox for live chat, WhatsApp, email, Instagram and Messenger

Bugalou is more than a live chat widget. It is a complete customer support platform with a shared inbox for your whole team.

  • Live chat from your WordPress website
  • WhatsApp Business: chat with customers on WhatsApp, with message templates (and broadcasts on Pro)
  • Email: connect Gmail, Outlook or any IMAP mailbox
  • Instagram DMs and Facebook Messenger, including replies to comments under your posts
  • Phone and SMS via Twilio (Pro plan)

Your team answers every channel from the same inbox, with the same tools.

👩‍💻 Team collaboration for customer support

  • Assign conversations to team members, or route them automatically with rules and round-robin
  • Internal notes and @mentions to ask a colleague without the customer seeing it
  • Snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders
  • Snippets (canned responses) for questions you answer every day
  • Team chat to talk with colleagues, with automatic translation on Pro
  • CSAT surveys, SLA timers and reports to see how your customer service performs

📣 Announcement bar and countdown banners

Promote a sale, free shipping or a new collection in a bar at the top or bottom of your pages. You create banners in your Bugalou dashboard under Campaigns → Banners and they show up on your site automatically, through the same chat script. No extra plugin or code needed.

  • Free plan: 1 active banner with your text, colours and a link
  • Paid plans: a live countdown timer, a discount code with a copy button, a newsletter signup form, a button that opens the live chat, ready-made templates (Black Friday, Christmas, Sale) and showing banners only on certain pages or devices

⚡ Automations

  • Automatic replies outside opening hours, with an away message on every channel
  • Rules that assign, tag or route conversations for you
  • Automatic WhatsApp and email messages, for example after an order (with the WooCommerce or Shopify integration)

📚 Help center and contact forms

  • A help center with articles your visitors and the AI chatbot can use
  • Contact forms you can embed on any page, that land in the same inbox

🛒 Running a WooCommerce store?

Use Bugalou for WooCommerce instead. It includes the same live chat widget and also connects your orders, so your team sees a customer’s orders right next to the chat and the AI chatbot can answer order and tracking questions.

🔒 GDPR and data in the EU

Bugalou stores customer data on servers in the EU (Frankfurt) and is fully GDPR-compliant, with a data processing agreement for every customer. The plugin itself loads nothing until you add your widget key and switch the chat on. See “External services” below for exactly what is sent.

How it works

  1. Install and activate this plugin.
  2. In your Bugalou dashboard, go to Channels → Website chat → Installation and click “Copy key” in the “Widget key” box at the top.
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings → Bugalou Live Chat, paste the key, tick “Show the chat widget on my site” and save.

Bugalou account required

This plugin shows the live chat of your Bugalou account, an external service, so you need a Bugalou account to use it.

  • Free plan: website live chat for 1 user, up to 50 conversations a month, and 1 announcement banner, free forever. No AI chatbot, and “Powered by Bugalou” is shown in the chat and the banner.
  • Starter: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email in one inbox, replies to comments under your posts, automations, team chat and countdown banners.
  • Pro: everything in Starter plus the AI chatbot, routing, CSAT, SLA timers, broadcasts and phone and SMS.

Create a free account to start; every paid plan also comes with a free 14-day trial. See all plans on the pricing page.

External services

This plugin loads the chat widget of Bugalou, an external customer service platform.

  • What is loaded, and when: only after you paste a widget key and enable “Show the chat widget on my site”, your site loads Bugalou’s chat script from https://bugalou.com/widget/loader.js for visitors. Until then the plugin loads nothing on your site.
  • What is sent: the script loads your widget settings from https://bugalou.com and, when a visitor uses the chat, sends the messages they type, any name, email or file they choose to share and their browser language to Bugalou, so your team and the AI assistant can answer in your Bugalou inbox. As with any web request, the visitor’s IP address and the page address are visible to Bugalou’s server. The script stores a chat session id in the visitor’s browser (local storage) so the conversation continues across pages.
  • Announcement banners: the same chat script also loads Bugalou’s banner script from https://bugalou.com/banners/widget.js when your Bugalou account has an active banner. To pick the banners for the page, it sends the page path and whether the visitor uses a mobile or desktop device to Bugalou, and it reports when a banner is shown, clicked or closed (no visitor data, only the banner id). Only when a visitor types their email address into a banner’s signup form is that address sent to Bugalou and saved as a contact in your account. Closed banners and signups are remembered in the visitor’s browser (local storage), so a closed banner stays closed on your site.

  • Apart from the above, the plugin sends no data and does not track visitors.

  • Bugalou terms of service

  • Bugalou privacy policy
sections.installation:
Watch the setup in 45 seconds:

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/bugalou-live-chat, or install it directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Bugalou Live Chat to add your widget key.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Bugalou account?

Yes. Create a free Bugalou account, then copy your widget key from the “Widget key” box under Channels → Website chat → Installation.

Is it really free?

Yes. The free plan includes website chat for 1 user and up to 50 conversations a month, with no time limit and no credit card. The AI assistant and other channels are part of the paid plans.

Does the chat slow down my site?

No. The script loads asynchronously in the footer, after your page content.

Where do I change the colours and texts of the chat?

In your Bugalou dashboard under Channels → Website chat. Changes show up on your site right away, without touching WordPress.

How do I add a banner with a countdown?

In your Bugalou dashboard, go to Campaigns → Banners, click “Create banner”, pick a template or write your own text, switch on the countdown and click Activate. The banner shows up on your site right away. The countdown timer is part of the paid plans.

I also use Bugalou for WooCommerce. Will the chat show twice?

No. Both plugins use the same script, which is loaded only once. On a store you only need Bugalou for WooCommerce.

Does the free plan include the AI chatbot?

No. The free plan is live chat for 1 user. The AI chatbot that answers visitors 24/7 is part of the Pro plan, which you can try free for 14 days.

Can I connect WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email?

Yes, from the Starter plan. All channels land in the same inbox as your website live chat, so your team answers everything from one place.

Can my whole team answer live chats?

Yes. Invite colleagues to your Bugalou account and assign conversations to them, by hand or automatically. Extra users cost €12 per user per month on Starter and Pro.

Can I answer live chats on my phone?

Yes. Bugalou works in the browser on your phone and can be installed as an app on iPhone and Android from your browser, with notifications for new messages.

Is Bugalou GDPR compliant?

Yes. Customer data is stored in the EU (Frankfurt) and a data processing agreement is included. The plugin only loads the live chat after you add your widget key and switch it on.
